profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Meta Super Intelligence Labs
profile.summary:
Eric is a software engineer at Facebook, where he works on the company's software infrastructure. He has also recently written a book: https://bit.ly/3ZVsIpv.

In his free time, he is an avid runner who has twice run the full marathon at the Tennessee Mountain Man Memorial March and competed in multiple triathlons.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer MSL Meta AI Search
positions.description: Working on meta.ai for Meta Super Intelligence Labs focused on leading the system foundation and LLM evaluations to support the AI Agentic product application for Meta.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Ads
positions.description:
Experienced TL Optimizing ads delivery for the Facebook App and solving complex problems other senior / staff engineers cannot.

Previously worked on messaging product foundations contact/search ranking and E2EE encrypted messaging

positions.title: Software Engineer Messenger Kids ML Foundations
positions.description:
1. Led Global Launch For Messenger Kids Increased Global MAP 5x
2. Led project to build a lightweight ranking engine for Messenger Kids engagement features
2. Led projects to improve ML infrastructure on Messenger Kids resulting in better alerting/monitoring and improving efficiency for ML engineers.

positions.title: Rotational Software Engineer
positions.description: Disaster Recovery - Marketplace Search Ranking Infra

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Eric works as part of the mobile team for iOS focused on developing and maintaining rich user-focused features related to onboarding, referrals, and user acquisition. He works with the broader iOS team as well as the Rails web team to implement architecture improvements, coordinate releases, design APIs, develop internal tools, and interface with business partners.

- Implemented and optimized feature performance of highly utilized in-app game experience (fifty-five thousand users per day).
- A vocal leader in fostering a team environment and helps lead meetings to drive decisions based on both technical and business constraints.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Eric is a Technical Consultant specializing in iOS mobile development.  At Acumen he has worked on a variety of projects primarily utilizing Swift, Javascript, and APEX where he as excelled at building user friendly mobile first software that exceeds client expectations. 

Acumen Projects:

- Enterprise iOS application for a fortune 500 company centered around increasing ground sales conversion rates 
     - (OBJ-C)

-Internal iOS application that connects to a Salesforce API.  The iOS app is centered on viewing all company employees and their upcoming schedules.
    - (Swift, APEX)

- Developed Mobile POC showcasing the benefits of utilizing a native app in terms of UI customization and session management utilizing the Salesforce OAuth protocol. 
    - (Swift, APEX).

positions.title: Co-Founder/CTO
positions.description:
As a co-founder Eric works on all aspects of the Consult Mango; from selling the product, to being the lead software developer on the agile development team.  Eric has worked to create sass model software products utilizing Ruby on Rails, Swift, and Java Spring frameworks. 

In addition to software development, Eric has worked to foster many international business contracts in China, Nigeria, and India.  He also presented at the COSE Small Business competition where Mango took third place out of over 100 competitors.

Mango Projects:
- Insight Platform: A 100% translatable student application platform backed by an algorithm that helps students to match with Colleges and Universities they would excel at.  Through the technology developed Mango was able to place a handful of students. 
    - (Java, Spring MVC, Javascript, jQuery, HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3).

- Analytics Dashboard: An in browser analytics dashboard with visual graphics that enabled users to easily track statistics on their advertising campaigns.  The dashboard serviced 10 colleges for four month advertising campaigns.
    - (Ruby on Rails, Javascript, jQuery, HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3).

- Recruit Mango: An iOS app backed by an implicit OAuth protected API which allows colleges to collect leads through their iOS device and then create targeted marketing campaigns, track progress, and view analytic reports through the web platform and user dashboard.
    - (Ruby on Rails, Javascript, AngularJS, HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3).

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked with the VBS2 and Unity game engines to further develop the war game simulators that the Army develops and utilizes.  Worked to develop a new version of the IZLID hand held laser for game.  During the internship period Eric was able to design the IZLID and place it into the game for the next release.

positions.description: Lead a small team to design, code, test, and support chapter web site.  Utilized Windows Server, SQL Server, HTML, Flash, JavaScript, and CSS.  In addition to software development duties, he also served as the system administrator.
